const urls = [
  "https://global.v2ex.co/t/1213026",
  "https://www.vgover.com/news/239696",
  "https://linux.do/t/topic/2624207/252",
  "https://cloud.kepuchina.cn/h5/detail?id=7371609296767520768",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "let i=0;",
  "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setsetTimeout(r,ms)});}",
  "async function next(){",
  "  if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
  "  const u=cfg.urls[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  await sleep(i===1?1500:9000);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36','Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',async function(){",
  "      let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      b=b.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
  "      b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/“/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/”/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/…/g,'...');",
  "      b=b.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      console.log('===== '+u+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
  "      console.log(b.substring(0,4000));",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('===== '+u+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-alt9.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-alt9.cjs";
